generated_client: out-of-repo: the three adapters speak hand-written API seams (pkg/city*/contract.go); the generated v1 client is the Team Server's artifact and its digest is not resolvable from gascity, so this manifest asserts no digest for it
findings: AC2/checkpoint-namespace (RESOLVED, API-7.23 divergence fix): cityneutral.CheckpointKey and cityartifact.CheckpointKey were byte-identical for a run and an artifact sharing a native ID, and their State documents cross-decode without error, so under one shared checkpoint store the neutral adapter erased the artifact adapter's frontier. Every adapter's key now carries its domain in the third segment (kind/source/run/<id>, kind/source/artifact/<id>, kind/source/inference), matching what cityinference already did. Proof: TestCheckpointKeysAreDomainDisjoint. Migration: each adapter reads its pre-domain key once on a miss and copies it forward under the domained key, adopting it only when the document carries that domain's own discriminator; see LegacyCheckpointKey and TestForeignLegacyCheckpointIsNotAdopted.

AC2/reset (RESOLVED, API-7.23 divergence fix): a bare epoch advance could not tell a declared reset from a mistyped config, and the three adapters each guessed differently - cityneutral and cityartifact restarted the checkpoint, cityinference refused every mismatch and never wrote the new epoch, so it stayed refused until an operator cleared the checkpoint by hand. A reset is now declared explicitly (Source.Reset: from-epoch, to-epoch, reason, declarer). All three honour a declared advance, write the new epoch and record the declaration, refuse an undeclared advance with ErrIdentityDrift, and refuse a backwards epoch. Proof: TestDeclaredResetIsHandledUniformly. Open gap: the declaration is checked, not authenticated - this repository has no signer for it.

AC2/rollback (RESOLVED, API-7.23 divergence fix): all three producers now carry Producer.Disabled and refuse with their own ErrDisabled, issuing no request and touching no checkpoint. Proof: TestRollbackSwitchIsUniform.
AC3/generated-client: not resolvable from this repository; see generated_client above.
